criteria.requirement: Implement charset_normalizer.compressed.from_compressed_path(path, *, format, max_bytes, read_size=65536, **options). Use actual gzip/bz2/xz readers with a required decompressed-byte budget (at most one extra sentinel to detect overflow), then delegate complete payload detection to from_bytes. Report compressed/decoded byte sizes, support empty and multistream gzip, and fail on corruption/truncation/overrun without partial-success claims or modifying source files. Never auto-guess compressed formats or add remote I/O.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
